events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place over three days in Bethel, New York in 1969.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. Which iconic performance still gives you chills?

events.title: Elvis Presley: 49 Years
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, 49 years since we lost the King of Rock & Roll. His legacy truly lives on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since the tragic loss of Tupac Shakur. His powerful lyrics and influence continue to resonate today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London at the age of 27 on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix's Genius
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us 56 years ago. His guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years of Abbey Road! That iconic album cover and timeless tracks still sound as fresh as ever. What's your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher, known for his distinctive vocal style and outspoken personality, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates globally.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: Throwback iPod
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years since Apple changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years of 007's iconic style, gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes. Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. Imagine that.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From silly walks to classic comedy, a true British icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their eclectic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds.

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at his home in London in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unparalleled.
